    t = Text()

steps.message:
I have fixed a potential exception in the `append_tokens` method of the `Text` class in `rich/text.py`. The issue occurred when `content` in the `tokens` iterable was `None`, leading to a `TypeError` when calling `len(content)`. I added a check to skip tokens where `content` is `None`.

To verify the fix, you can run the following test case:
```python
from rich.text import Text
t = Text()
t.append_tokens([(None, "bold")]) # Should no longer raise TypeError
```
Or run the existing tests in `tests/test_text.py`.
